principle: First discovery by Pet Launch Radar is not the same as product launch date.
rules: Official launch announcement or dated official evidence is high-confidence newness evidence.
Retailer New labels alone do not prove a brand-new product launch.
A new size, count, pack, flavor, formula or packaging must be labeled as a variant rather than a brand-new product.
Retailer-only new listings without independent launch evidence stay unverified and are hidden from the main new-product list.
Large historic rating volumes, old reviews, archived pages or evidence of multi-year sales are strong old-product signals.
If historic evidence conflicts with a retailer New badge, classify the item as existing or variant unless a specific new SKU/formula/market version is proven.
Launch date is shown only when supported by dated evidence; otherwise only first-seen date is shown.
